question: In NSCLC trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.

target_pairs.output_name: Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Control

augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall", "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Control" FROM clinical_trials
